rationale: Although GGAL is grinding near its session high of $35.84 after a strong intraday recovery above VWAP ($34.75), current 1-minute volume is extremely thin (under 1,500 shares on four of the last five bars) and the bid-ask spread is wide at 16.8 bps ($0.06), which is nearly half of the 5-minute ATR ($0.13).
